items.title: OKXICE to debut tokenized stock trading with Strategy, Coinbase, Circle this month
items.summary: After initial issuer pushback, the blockchain venue is set to start trading on Nov. 23 and said will list over 70 assets, including Strategy’s common and preferred shares and 59 of Direxion's ETFs.

items.title: Meet Spiko, the largest tokenized fund in the world you’ve probably never heard about
items.summary: The firm’s flagship Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund (SAFO) held $2.39 billion in assets under management as of late last month.

items.title: Live news: Bitcoin remains under pressure as CoreWeave, Nvidia lead AI rebound
items.summary: The DRAM ETF jumps 8% and semiconductor stocks gain more than 4%, while bitcoin continues to test its 200-day moving average.

items.title: Bitcoin barely flinches at hot CPI as ETF selling slows
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 11, 2026

items.title: Bitcoin sits out stock rebound as ETF outflows extend to fourth day
items.summary: Bitcoin held steady near $74,000 as Tuesday's hot inflation figure lifted the odds on a U.S. interest-rate increase to around 90%. ETF outflows extended to a fourth day and liquidations jumped.

items.title: Kraken's xStocks adds 200 UK and EU shares as its assets top $1.1 billion
items.summary: Payward says xStocks holds over $1.1 billion. Each token is backed by a share but gives no ownership of the underlying company.

items.title: Bitcoin stuck under $74,000 as CoreWeave earnings revive AI outlook, Anthropic said to raise IPO valuation
items.summary: CoreWeave’s revenue surge lifted AI infrastructure stocks and Nasdaq futures, while bitcoin was little changed over 24 hours.

items.title: Warren: What is White House doing to prevent a repeat of teleprompter's Trump bets?
items.summary: U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren argued the administration is not doing enough about staff insider trading, questioning whether CFTC enforcement action was sufficient.

items.title: Former NYSE president says stock issuers hold the key to tokenization as Bullish builds its platform
items.summary: Stacey Cunningham, who recently joined digital asset platform Bullish as President, sees the company’s planned Equiniti acquisition and focus on stock issuers as key to its tokenization ambitions.

items.title: Goldman Sachs, Citi among banks said to commit $270 million to stablecoin venture
items.summary: The venture, known as Project Faro, plans to issue a dollar-denominated stablecoin and is expected to be incorporated in the U.S.

items.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
items.summary: Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts
items.summary: Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline.

items.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 5: MATT and OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY — How Bitcoin could carry state across transactions
items.summary: OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs.

items.title: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates
items.summary: CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion.

items.title: FSB urgest Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules
items.summary: The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators.

items.title: Zcash falls below $1,000 for first time since September
items.summary: Zcash fell nearly 15% amid a broader sell-off in privacy coins, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to ecosystem initiatives.

items.title: Barclays boosts BlackRock Bitcoin ETF stake 48% as banks expand holdings
items.summary: Barclays reported a $187 million stake as of Sept. 30, while Citigroup disclosed a new $119 million position in Fidelity’s Bitcoin ETF.

items.title: Kraken parent adds over 200 tokenized UK and EU stocks to xStocks
items.summary: The expansion adds more than 200 tokenized UK and EU equities, including all 40 companies in Germany’s DAX index, as xStocks plans further expansion into Hong Kong.

items.title: Bitcoin short-term holders send 47K BTC to exchanges at a loss
items.summary: Bitcoin fell to an 11-week low of $72,670 after slipping below short-term holders’ average cost basis of about $75,700, according to CryptoQuant.

items.title: Decrypt Becomes First News Publisher to Offer Perps Trading, Powered by Solana's Phoenix
items.summary: The integration brings perpetual futures trading into Decrypt, so readers can trade crypto, stocks and commodities without leaving the news.

items.title: Morning Minute: What Anthropic’s $1.4 Trillion IPO Means for Crypto
items.summary: Hint: if it plays out similarly to the SpaceX IPO, it means the Bitcoin bottom is very close.

items.title: Kraken Parent Payward Brings 200 UK and EU Stocks Onchain as xStocks
items.summary: The expansion takes xStocks past 1,500 tokenized assets, though the new UK tokens still can't be bought by investors in the UK.

items.title: Nvidia Sheds $430B in Two Days as Jensen Huang Faces Calls to Resign
items.summary: Nvidia's independent directors have hired Wachtell Lipton to investigate its CEO's ties to an alleged Chinese spy, as pressure mounts.

items.title: Avalanche Won Over the NYSE. Now It Has to ‘Capture Value’ for AVAX
items.summary: The New York Stock Exchange will use Avalanche infrastructure, but experts say that won't necessarily boost AVAX's price.

items.title: Prisoner Jailed for 8 Years Over $2.7M Crypto Theft Plot Run From His Cell
items.summary: Robert Barr planned to have accomplices force a crypto investor to install remote-access software so he could drain the wallet from prison.

items.title: Bitcoin Miner HIVE Eyes $45 Million in Annual Revenue From AI Deal
items.summary: The Bitcoin miner says its Boden facility could generate $45 million annually, but a June letter of intent remains nonbinding as executives negotiate financing and customer protections for the project.

items.title: Trump Media Posts $410 Million Profit. Bitcoin Gains Did the Heavy Lifting
items.summary: Truth Social’s parent booked $409.7 million in quarterly income largely from crypto investments, even as its stock remained more than 94% below its March 2024 peak.

items.title: Nvidia Erases 2026 Gains as Republicans Threaten Jensen Huang With Subpoena
items.summary: The chipmaker has erased its 2026 gains as a suspected Chinese espionage case brings fresh scrutiny of CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: Near AI Breach Exposes User Details and Data From 18 AI Agents
items.summary: An SGLang flaw let an attacker reach internal systems and potentially view confidential AI requests, exposing the limits of hardware-backed privacy protections.
